北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天，体感 31℃，有点闷热哦，注意补水防晒！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels warm and humid at 31℃. Stay hydrated and protect from sun!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风力 6级较大，体感凉爽，出门注意防风保暖哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has strong winds (level 6), feels cool. Mind the wind and keep warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感 33℃，注意防暑降温，避免长时间户外活动。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels 33℃, stay cool and avoid prolonged outdoor activities.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感 40℃ 高温，务必做好防晒，多喝水！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels 40℃, intense heat. Be sure to stay hydrated and protect from sun!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 37℃ 炎热，及时补充水分，注意防晒。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels 37℃ and hot. Hydrate well and protect from sun.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 30℃ 潮湿，记得带好雨具，注意防潮。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels 30℃ and humid. Bring an umbrella and mind the dampness.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阵雨，湿度 100%，出门记得带伞，小心路滑。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has showers, 100% humidity. Carry an umbrella and watch for slippery roads.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 37℃ 闷热，注意防暑降温，多喝水哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels 37℃ and muggy. Stay cool and drink plenty of water.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉 36℃ 高温，防暑是关键，避免中暑！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is 36℃, high heat. Staying cool is key, avoid heatstroke!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 34℃，天气炎热，注意多补水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels 34℃. It's hot, remember to hydrate.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆体感 40℃，炎热难耐，务必防晒，及时补水。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing feels 40℃, intensely hot. Be sure to protect from sun and hydrate.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阵雨，湿度 100%，出门带伞，小心路滑。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin has showers, 100% humidity. Bring an umbrella and watch for slippery roads.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，气温 30℃，湿度较高，出门记得带伞哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, 30℃ with high humidity. Remember to bring an umbrella.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明小雨，体感 24℃ 凉爽，出门记得带伞，小心着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has light rain, feels cool at 24℃. Bring an umbrella and avoid catching a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门风力 5级较大，体感 30℃，注意防风和补水哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has strong winds (level 5), feels 30℃. Mind the wind and stay hydrated.
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾，风力 5级，能见度低，注意出行安全。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has heavy fog and strong winds (level 5). Low visibility, travel safely.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 24℃，风力 5级较大，出门注意防风。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels 24℃, strong winds (level 5). Mind the wind when going out.
